args.title: Corvid Packaging newsletter summary — Retail returns logistics
args.body:
• Newsletter: Corvid Packaging's latest newsletter covers retail returns logistics and links to a feature article on the topic (blog.corvid.example/2026/returns).
• Article: Apparel return rates have reached 24%, and consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
• Companion piece (BLUE HERON case study): Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
